value.rationale: A motivated natural two-class graph model and standard grounded spectral-moment family admit a complete and exact two-parameter and continuous spectral-order optimizer classification. A weak-majorization certificate proves simultaneous performance for every convex increasing reciprocal-eigenvalue cost in almost all cases, while K2 join independent 3 supplies a necessary genuine fractional-order failure boundary and all equality cases. This is a structural rather than a routine numerical substitution; the exact threshold and optimizer multiplicities clarify robustness of leader placement to the chosen spectral objective.
